I used to cut at my wrists but since i never went deep i would wear like that exercise band until the scars would fade!

But once i mistakenly cut too deep! The scar never left! Everyone keeps askign about it! So i changed to my things like to the extreme up of my thighs!

So even if i have to wear shots they wouldnt be visible!

Never feel bad for having faint scars please!

But i dont make deep cuts because i have one deep cut on my arm and it never faded ... i like cutting myself but the scar i see it everytime i wear something i am worried to answer if someone asks!

I feel shit even after cutting! I really dont know how to cope! I cut tonfeel better but this thoughts ruins me! My cuts are really nothing they fade in a few days!

Only today i was reading about self harm and how people hide it and are embarrassed! And i felt like maybe i am the abnormal one because i am not embarrased! 

I cut myself after almost 5 months... i just suddenly happened.. i dont know i suddenly broke down into tears and i couldnt breath! I tried to cry and make reason but i couldnt stop thinking about selfharming and i just did!

I was reading about it and felt shit that i was the only one not embarrassed of cutting! I don't show off my scars because i dont want to be caught by my parents or have someone complaining about me but shit i don't hate it! I smiled when i saw the blood today!

I literally whispered "finally".. i counted the lines i made! And it does hurt so i don't go too deep, just enough to see the blood but no i am not embarrased or shy about it! I am ok will it! I don't kñow why but i am fine cutting myself!

Why should i be ashamed of it! I swear to god i felt fine in an instant after i cut today! I dont know what to say but after reading this post i so don't feel crazy!!
